name: web-frosted-dashboard-tilted-over-desert-sunset
title: Frosted Dashboard Tilted over Desert
whatItIs: A cream, frosted-glass analytics dashboard tilted steeply over a golden-hour desert photo, with a serif 'Explore your performance' banner, sidebar and product table.
whatItMeans: Warm sky and dune tones make data feel calm and premium. The serif headline adds editorial warmth to a business tool.
techniques: Frosted panel blending into a photo background
Serif headline inside a sans-serif UI
Steep perspective tilt with cropped edges
Yellow gradient banner echoing the sunset
Rounded nested cards with soft shadows

vocabulary.definition: A translucent blurred surface showing the background.
Combining a serif and a sans-serif for contrast.
Rotating a flat UI in 3D space.
